mod.note: reads 8 bytes at image offset 0 through host_api.image_read()

meaning: A mod read the real running image through the host API. 4d5a is the DOS header signature, so the bytes can only come from the mapped executable; the read was gated by build_matches (8/8 anchors).
limits: Read-only, and only when the fingerprint matches. The same API refuses reads in a host without a verified image (loader scenario image_access_refused_without_image) and refuses out-of-range offsets (image_access_refuses_out_of_range).
